long_biography.plain_text:
Golden Heights places Sten Warborn at the head of a major Swedish jewellery-retail group. Trained in business and economics, he joined the company's board in 2006 and became chairman in 2014. He indirectly owns all shares and also works across accounting, cash management and group administration.

The operating business sits within Iduna, whose Swedish chains include Guldfynd, Hallbergs Guld and Albrekts Guld, alongside a Finnish retail network. Warborn's role combines shareholder control with board oversight and continuing group-level management. Daily company leadership is separately assigned, leaving him responsible for ownership and strategic direction rather than every operating function.
